thread:
Linh: Posting consolidated follow-ups from yesterday's Cobalt Dedicated postmortem — VPC peering flap + on-prem isolation bug. Quick thread to capture owners, timelines, and one-shot mitigations.

Jon: Thanks — I'll own the peering remediation. Will add a small playbook and validation steps.

Maya: I'll pick up the on-prem handshake timeout and the regression harness for customer's air-gapped setup.

Priya: I'll draft the customer-facing timeline and coordinate an optional maintenance window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary rollout for peering fix -> staging @ 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z. Will notify on success/fail.

Linh: Action list (condensed):
1) Repair asymmetric route advertisement that caused split-brain traffic (owner: Jon) — target due 2026-03-28.
2) Harden on-prem handshake and retry backoff (owner: Maya) — target due 2026-03-26.
3) Add short-circuit circuit-breaker on cross-region routing to prevent cascade (owner: Linh) — target due 2026-04-01.
4) Add nightly regression that replays failing traffic pattern (owner: Maya) — target due 2026-03-31.
5) Customer comms + maintenance window (owner: Priya) — draft due 2026-03-27.
6) Add observability metric: `peering_handshake_retries` alert at >5/min (owner: Jon) — target due 2026-03-29.

Jon: Short checklist I'm starting with:
- identify peering route-map mismatch (done, see infra branch)
- apply fix to route advertisement (staging)
- run `ip route` validation and traffic replay

Snippet I'm using to validate routes locally:
```bash
# staging validation
ip route show table 100
# ensure peer route points at edge-1
ip route add 10.12.0.0/16 via 192.168.254.1 table 100 || true
```

Maya: Validation plan for on-prem: quick python harness that replays TCP handshake under constrained MTU and artificially high latency, then asserts session recovery within 3s. Will attach test to nightly CI. Also patch will drop handshake timeout from 10s -> 5s and add exponential backoff cap.

Priya: Customer note draft (short): "We identified a VPC route asymmetry and an on-prem handshake regression causing intermittent isolation for dedicated customers during scale spikes. We're applying staged fixes this week; we'll publish a timeline and optional maintenance window. — Priya"

Linh: Observations / recurring pattern:
- These peering flaps correlate with scale events (~>8k rps) + transient kernel queue drops on customer on-prem GW.
- Root cause is a combination of route distribution mismatch and a brittle handshake retry policy in our on-prem agent.
- Suggest we track as a recurring pattern: `peering-scale-handshake` and add to quarterly reliability review.

sre-rotation-bot: Incident tracker updated: INC-2026-132 assigned -> Jon. Priority: P2.

Jon: Quick note — adding `peering_handshake_retries` to alerting with a 5m burn rate threshold. Will open PR by EOD.

Maya: I'll own the nightly regression test PR. Tagging eng-platform for CI runners that can run behind a synthetic on-prem gateway.

Linh: Ownership confirmation: Jon, Maya, Priya. Please reply with :thumbsup: or proposed alternate owners.

Jon: :+1:

Maya: :thumbsup:

Priya: Ack. Draft out in #customer-comm DOCS, will link once ready.

Linh: Putting a weekly follow-up checkpoint — add to remediation-sync on Thursdays. If any blocker, ping here.

Priya: FYI customer asked for ETA; I'll give tentative ETA of 2026-03-28 for peering remediation and 2026-03-26 for on-prem patch, marking as tentative until staging validation completes.

Jon: Will update INC ticket and post staging logs here when canary run completes.

Linh: Thanks all — recording this as the canonical action docket for the Cobalt Dedicated postmortem. Will close thread once all items have PRs and dates verified.
